**Tier 4 Basic Spark Essence x 1000 **Tier 3 Class Spark Crystal x 1 == Chapter 1 - Noise Disturbance == [[File:Bring the Noise Chapter 1.jpg|thumb|150px]] === Ruckus Identified === Part 1 *[[Ratchet]]: ''Optimus, we're getting readings of audio disturbances from the southern region with seismic ramifications.'' *[[Optimus Prime]]: ''What could be causing such a ruckus?'' *Ratchet: ''Not what, but who. Audio diagnostics I ran indicate a bot is responsible for this voluminous "disturbance.'' *Optimus Prime: ''Soundwave?'' *Ratchet: ''Uhh, no. The audio signature is Autobot in origin.'' *[[Bumblebee]]: ''There is only one Autobot that could bring that ruckus... Blaster is in the house!'' Part 2 *Ratchet: ''Commander, Optimus, the audio levels are getting worse... to the point of being destructive.'' *Optimus Prime: ''Recommended course of action?'' *[[Ultra Magnus]]: ''With all due respect, Optimus, the course of action is obvious. We have to find Blaster and unplug him.'' *Optimus Prime: ''"Unplug" is an extreme measure.'' *Ratchet: ''I'm sure he means that figuratively. But, we do need to "unplug" him until he realizes the damage his decibels can do in the unstable atmosphere of New Quintessa.'' Part 3 *[[Blaster]]: ''Look who dropped in to get down! My main bot, Optimus!'' *Optimus Prime: ''We did not come here to get down. We are here to turn down... the noise.'' *Blaster: ''Aw c'mon. I know Primes don't party, but this place needs to get its groove on. The bots here are too uptight for their own good.'' *Ratchet: ''I know you mean well...'' *Ultra Magnus: ''But the party is over. Let's go, and hold it down.'' *Blaster: ''No can do, Ultra Serious. The music is in me and there's no stopping it. Get beat or get beats... it's your choice.'' === Party Getting Started === Part 1 *[[Bumblebee (DOTM)]]: ''Yo' Bee.'' *[[Bumblebee]]: ''Yeah, Bee?'' *Bumblebee (DOTM): ''Man, the whole alternate reality doppelganger thing is weird. Anyway, what do you know about this Blaster bot?'' *Bumblebee: ''Aw, Blaster is a stand up, get down Autobot. He's loyal to both the Autobots and his love of getting the party started. Why do you ask?'' *Bumblebee (DOTM): ''Well, there's been bit of a problem. The Commander and Ultra Magnus tried to bring him in to HQ and turn down the volume.'' *Bumblebee: ''Oh-oh.'' *Bumblebee (DOTM): ''Oh-oh is right. They had him under control when his cassettes ejected and sprung him loose.'' *Bumblebee: ''That means the party is just getting started.'' Part 2 *Optimus Prime: ''What are you doing here, soldier? You were assigned to recon patrol in the northern sector.'' *Bumblebee (DOTM): ''Sorry, but I got sidetracked helping a friend help a friend.'' *Optimus Prime: ''If this is about Blaster, the Commander and I will handle it. You have your orders. Carry them out.'' *Bumblebee (DOTM): ''You're not the boss of me. Sure you're a Prime, but you're not my Prime.'' *Optimus Prime: ''In times of duress we must endeavor to remain united. Return to the base, do your duty.'' *Bumblebee (DOTM): ''Some other time... Prime.'' Part 3 *Optimus Prime: ''Commander, the heavy reverb and pulsating bass suggest Blaster lies ahead.'' *Bumblebee (DOTM): ''Lay off him. As someone that spent years with a broken vocal box cranking out random radio hits and movie quotes, I know what it's like to be misunderstood.'' *Optimus Prime: ''That was not of my doing or my concern.'' My concern is our present safety.'''' *Bumblebee (DOTM): ''C'mon Optimus Downer, sometimes you have to let a bot find himself. You've gotta let Blaster be Blaster.'' *Optimus Prime: ''That is a terrible idea. Blaster's audio input endangers us all.'' *Bumblebee (DOTM): ''Does it? Or, does it just annoy you that someone is enjoying the right of all sentient beings... to be free to be oneself?'' == Chapter 2 - Put It on Blast == [[File:Bring the Noise Chapter 2.jpg|thumb|150px]] ===Fight the Power=== Part 1 *Optimus Prime: ''Optimus, if I may be so bold... what has possessed "your" Bee? His stubborn insubordination worries me.'' *[[Optimus Prime (MV1)]]: ''I fear stubbornness is a trait all Bees may possess.'' *Optimus Prime: ''The Bee I know would never disobey me.'' *Optimus Prime (MV1): ''I would not be so sure. My Bee said they are united in allowing this Blaster bot of yours to... I believe he said... "find his groove".'' *Optimus Prime: ''If we are to restore a semblance of order and stability, Blaster and his "groove" must be found.'' Part 2 *Bumblebee: ''Yo' Bee, what's the deal?'' *Bumblebee (DOTM): ''I tried to hold them off, but that Commander has a stacked squad.'' *Bumblebee: ''Thanks, bud, but it's my turn now. I'll slow them down and buy him some time.'' *Bumblebee (DOTM): ''Time for what?'' *Bumblebee: ''I talked with him and he says he's working on a new jam. He's claiming it's good enough to soothe a savage Dinobot.'' *Bumblebee (DOTM): ''Wow, quite the claim.'' *Bumblebee: ''Yeah, but I figure we oughta give him a shot at it. Grimlock's been acting rowdier than usual lately.'' Part 3 *Optimus Prime: ''Say it is not so. You too?'' *Bumblebee: ''Me too, what... Optimus?'' *Optimus Prime: ''You too are in league with Blaster as he lays sonic waste to the land.'' *Bumblebee: ''I'm not in league with anyone. I'm just trying to help a bro-bot find his groove.'' *Optimus Prime: ''Translation?'' *Bumblebee: ''I know you don't get it, but Blaster is an artist. It's in his park. He has to get it out, then he'll be fine.'' *Optimus Prime: ''Get it out?! Bumblebee, get out of the way!'' *Bumblebee: ''Not yet, sir. Blaster needs to kick out his jam. If that means I need to fight the power... so be it!'' ===Primes Don't Party=== Part 1 *[[Megatron]]: ''Are we not through with you yet?'' *[[Starscream]]: ''Are you through with winning?'' *Megatron: ''You are hardly one to speak of winning.'' *Starscream: ''But, I have a plan. One that exploits the Primes' weakness.'' *Megatron: ''And I have a brain and a giant gun. But, I suppose it would not hurt to discuss the Primes' weaknesses. What do you propose?'' *Starscream: ''Recently, the Autobot Blaster has surfaced on new Quintessa. All reports are that he is driving the Primes mad with his incessant music playing.'' *Megatron: ''Everyone knows Primes don't party. So what?'' *Starscream: ''So we grab Blaster, trick him into playing his annoying ditty, and zap him with a T-Cog Disabler...'' *Megatron: ''And use him to push the Primes over the edge. Create chaos of the sonic persuasion. Hmmm...'' Part 2 *Blaster: ''Starscream? What are you doing here? Don't you have a back to stab somewhere?'' *Starscream: ''Tsk-tsk, my fellow Cybertronian. I am a non-aligned bot of peace here on this deranged planet. You might say I follow the beat of own drummer.'' *Blaster: ''I can get behind that, kinda going solo myself. But, what's that funky gadget?'' *Starscream: ''A T-Cog Disabler.'' *Blaster: ''What does it do?'' *Starscream: ''You are as dumb as you are loud. I'll show you what it does if you show me that song everyone says you're working on.'' *Blaster: ''I'm always down to get down, but I've got to transform first.'' *Starscream: ''Sucker.'' *Blaster:
Argh!!!!
Part 3 *[[Sideswipe]]: ''Hey Optimus, looks like bringing me on the mission was a good call. Look who I found... Blaster!'' *Optimus Prime: ''So I can hear. His choice in music is still as terrible as ever.'' *Bumblebee: ''Yo, Blasty... it sounds like you've found your jam. Now, transform and let's roll out.'' *Optimus Prime: ''You heard Bumblebee. Transform, it is time to go.'' *Starscream: ''Why the rush? Maybe he just wants to bump his beats. Or maybe, he can't transform. Either way it sounds like we've got a party.'' *Optimus Prime: ''What have you done to him?'' *Starscream: ''Why, I've merely set him free to bring the noise.'' *Bumblebee: ''Oh yeah, Decepticreep? You're going to see what it's like when a Killa Bee brings it!'' Part 4 *Sideswipe: ''Jeez, what a piece of work. As soon as we save his beat blasting butt he lays down a circuit jamming track and takes off.'' *Bumblebee: ''He's on a mission... a mission from Primus!'' *Optimus Prime: ''That just means our mission continues. Roll Out!'' == Chapter 3 - Last Dance == [[File:Bring the Noise Chapter 3.jpg|thumb|150px]] ===Superior Beats=== Part 1 *Megatron: ''Let me guess you sniveling sycophant, you have failed me again. And, as always, I'm sure it wasn't your fault.'' *Starscream: ''But, it wasn't.'' *Megatron: ''Of course.'' *Starscream: ''The plan was sound, but I didn't account for Bumblebee's love of Blaster's wretched noise pollution.'' *Megatron: ''Failure is failure.'' *Starscream: ''A setback is not a failure. It is a learning opportunity. Blaster still has the potential to be a weapon of mass distortion. You'll see.'' Part 2 *[[Soundwave]]: ''Lord Megatron, Shockwave has informed me that you collude with Starscream.'' *Megatron: ''There is no collusion. I merely let the fool carry out an attempt to disrupt the Autobot forces using their own Blaster against them.'' *Soundwave: ''Starscream and Blaster are both inferior bots. The potential for success was minimal. You only need to enlist the services of a superior bot... me.'' *Megatron: ''If my datadrive serves me correctly, did Blaster not prove superior at your infamous Dancitron beat battle?'' *Soundwave: ''That was an anomaly. My sub-woofer was malfunctioning.'' *Megatron: ''Yet another excuse for another flunky that fails me.'' *Soundwave: ''Your assessment is incorrect. I will prove my worth in the realm of audio warfare.'' *Megatron: ''Actions speak louder than words. Prove it.'' Part 3 *Soundwave: ''Cease your forward movement.'' *Sideswipe: ''Huh?'' *Bumblebee: ''I think he wants us to stop.'' *Sideswipe: ''Why didn't he say so?'' *Bumblebee: ''Whatever, we aren't stopping till we get our block rocking buddy Blaster back.'' *Soundwave: ''That will not happen.'' *Sideswipe: ''What's the deal, Soundwave... your cassettes need rewinding?'' *Soundwave: ''Megatron needs verification.'' *Bumblebee: ''Verification of what?'' ===Time to Dance=== Part 1 *Bumblebee: ''Things are popping out in the Wastelands, Optimus.'' *Optimus Prime: ''I am sure they are, whatever that means. Do you have any word on Blaster?'' *Bumblebee: ''Other than that he is a peacock and you've gotta let him fly?'' *Optimus Prime: ''If my knowledge of Earth ornithology is correct, peacocks do not fly. But, that is beside the point. Clarify.'' *Bumblebee: ''I'm just saying that he's an artist... he needs to express himself.'' *Optimus Prime: ''He will be a dead artist if Soundwave and the Decepticons have their way.'' *Sideswipe: ''Optimus is right, Bee. This has to end.'' *Bumblebee: ''I suppose you're fight. But, I'm thinking Blaster has one more encore in him.'' Part 2 *Blaster: ''What's cracking, Bee? I haven't seen you in a hot minute.'' *Bumblebee: ''Ah, you know... just been doing the scouting, fighting, looking for you thing.'' *Blaster: ''That's heavy, but I understand, bro-bot.'' *Bumblebee: ''The thing is, Optimus has a point. It's time for you to come in and jam with us... your band, your alliance... The Autobots.'' *Blaster: ''Yo' Bee, I'm not sure if I can give up the solo life just yet. Tell Optimus we need to get down one last time, a last chance to turn the funk out.'' *Bumblebee: ''He wins... you come home?'' *Blaster: ''Sounds like a deal for real, homebot.'' Part 3 *Optimus Prime: ''Has Blaster come to his senses?'' *Bumblebee: ''He's got one more track to lay down. Trust me, it's bad!'' *Optimus Prime: ''I know, that's why this must end.'' *Bumblebee: ''No, not bad meaning bad, but bad meaning good!'' *Optimus Prime: ''Bumblebee, this nonsense is over. Point the way to Blaster.'' *Bumblebee: ''Ok, Optimus. But, let him in on his own terms, to his own beat.'' *Optimus Prime: ''I make no promises, but if he is ready to deal... we will deal.'' Part 4 *Blaster: ''What's shaking, Optimus? Bee told me you'd be rolling through my hood.'' *Optimus Prime: ''Yes, I tend to roll everywhere. For the last time, please return with us to HQ... in silence.'' *Blaster: ''Before we do, it's time we dance... or we dance.'' *Optimus Prime: ''You know Primes do not party... nor dance. Explain yourself.'' *Blaster: ''I guess you're choosing to dance. Here's the deal. We get in on one last time while I play you my latest, greatest jam. You win... I leave with you. You lose, I get to keep kicking it solo.'' *Optimus Prime: ''Let us dance.'' ==Gallery== Bring the Noise Easy.jpg Bring the Noise Medium.jpg Bring the Noise Hard.jpg Bring the Noise Expert.jpg Bring the Noise Master.jpg Bring the Noise Chapter 1.jpg Bring the Noise Chapter 2.jpg Bring the Noise Chapter 3.jpg Bring the Noise newsfeed.png Bring the Noise mail.jpg Bring the Noise newsfeed banner.jpg Bring the Noise newsfeed.jpg Bring The Noise Special Mission Bundle Icon.png Bring The Noise Special Mission Bundle.jpg [[Category:Special Missions]]
